_comment: Source catalog. 'verified_at' records the last successful live check (robots.txt, HTTP status and parsing via `gccintel sources-verify`), run on 2026-11-14; failed checks keep their reason in verification_note. Reliability grades are PROVISIONAL defaults based on source type and ownership, not a measured track record; analysts must review them. News-media licences are marked review_required: an admin may approve them for limited use only (headlines, links and short excerpts) until a licence is recorded. Re-run `gccintel sources-verify --tenant <slug>` from the deployment network.
